page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel processing workloads. Running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, this instance features 54 dedicated physical CPU cores with one thread per core, providing 54 vCPUs. The hardware configuration includes 480.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 8.89 GB of RAM per core.

The server is equipped with eight NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined 128 GB of GPU VRAM. For local storage, the instance bundles 3779 GB of local SSD storage, which supports high-throughput data access directly on the node. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Because of the dense GPU configuration and substantial local SSD capacity, this instance is suited for deep learning training, high-performance computing, and large-scale parallel rendering tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without virtualization overhead, while the bundled local storage and high network bandwidth support data-intensive operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of eight GPUs and local SSD storage within a single instance provides a consolidated resource pool for workloads that would otherwise require multi-node clustering.
